metadata.case_name: RAI HARKA RAJ v. PACIFIC CROWN ENGINEERING LTD AND OTHERS

plaintiff.occupation_before: general labourer at a construction site

source: X ray examination shown fracture of second lumbar vertebra, left tibia and left fibula.
His spinal injuries were treated with spinal orthosis.
there were lacerations over his upper back
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of thorax

source: X ray examination shown fracture of second lumbar vertebra, left tibia and left fibula.
Open reduction and internal fixation was performed for the fractured left tibia on 21 August 2003.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lower leg, including ankle, unspecified

source: X ray examination shown fracture of second lumbar vertebra, left tibia and left fibula.

manifestations.description: step at the level of the second and third lumbar spine with swelling of the paraspinal area
left leg was swollen and bruised
power of his lower limbs was decreased
urodynamic study performed on 10 March 2004 shown decrease in bladder sensation and straining pattern during voiding
Uroflowmetry in March 2005 shown normal voiding
follow up uroflowmetry in January 2006 shown poor flow rate with straining pattern and increase in residual urine
Video urodynamic study on 26 January 2006 shown normal filling phase and failure in voiding; the Plaintiff had to sit and strain to pass urine
erectile dysfunction and penile pain on erection
presence of nocturnal erection at sleep
bulbo cavernosus reflex was very very weak
muscle wasting of left thigh (girth of thigh: 44 cm (right); 42 cm (left))

can walk for a short distance of around 30m without using a crutch; can walk continuously for 35 to 40 minutes with the aid of a crutch and then need to take a rest for 10 to 15 minutes; can stand for 5 minutes without a crutch but can stand for 10 to 15 minutes with the aid of a crutch; sitting tolerance of 2 hours; cannot stoop and has difficulties in climbing steps
sitting tolerance of 20 minutes to pass urine (needs 20 minutes to pass urine)

treatments_received.treatment: Accident and Emergency treatment at Princess Margaret Hospital (PMH)
source: After the accident, the Plaintiff was sent to the Accident and Emergency Department of Princess Margaret Hospital (“PMH”) for treatment.

treatments_received.treatment: Open reduction and internal fixation of fractured left tibia
source: Open reduction and internal fixation was performed for the fractured left tibia on 21 August 2003.
treatments_received.vmis_procedure: Open reduction for arm / leg / patella / scapula +/- internal fixation

source: His spinal injuries were treated with spinal orthosis.
During the first period of hospitalization, the Plaintiff developed urine retention. Foley catheterization was given, which was weaned off before his discharge.

treatments_received.treatment: Removal of screws from left foot
source: The Plaintiff was re-admitted on 28 February 2004 and screws were removed from his left foot on 1 March 2004.

treatments_received.treatment: Removal of metal plate and screws from left foot
source: Subsequently, the left foot fracture healed and metal plate and screws were removed on 12 October 2004.

treatments_received.treatment: Out-patient physiotherapy at Yan Chai Hospital
source: The Plaintiff received out-patient physiotherapy treatment at Yan Chai Hospital from 19 November 2003 to 23 June 2004.

treatments_received.treatment: Occupational therapy at Yan Chai Hospital
source: He also received further occupational therapy treatment at the same hospital between 27 March 2004 and 28 June 2004.
the Plaintiff also received Occupational Therapy from 30 July 2004 to 14 January 2005
physiotherapy between 12 July 2004 and 17 January 2005 at the PMH.
The urodynamic study performed on 10 March 2004 shown decrease in bladder sensation and straining pattern during voiding.
Uroflowmetry in March 2005 shown normal voiding.
Video urodynamic study on 26 January 2006 shown normal filling phase and failure in voiding.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: cannot assist his wife in carrying a load when shopping, carryout household and home improvement work

losses.category: Loss of sexual function and sexual life
losses.description: erectile dysfunction and penile pain on erection; nocturnal erection present suggesting part psychological and part neurogenic cause; very weak bulbo cavernosus reflex
limited walking and standing tolerance; cannot stoop and has difficulties in climbing steps; needs crutch for longer walking
